title: Gems & Crystals
description: A slowly turning cluster of gemstones and mineral crystals on a rocky matrix. Raw crystal habits — brassy pyrite and clear salt cubes, quartz, amethyst and citrine points, emerald prisms, watermelon tourmaline, bladed selenite and fluorite octahedra — sit alongside traditional faceted cuts: a round-brilliant diamond, a cushion-cut ruby and an oval-cut sapphire. Each stone is a little polyhedron built from its real crystal habit or gem cut and lit facet by facet against a velvet dark field, so faces catch and lose a studio light as the druse rotates. Translucent gems let their back facets glow through with a soft rim, pyrite reads as brushed metal with fine striations, tourmaline and selenite carry lengthwise grooves, and the brightest facets throw four-point star glints. Choose a single stone or a mixed druse; crystal count, cluster size, spin, light angle, facet contrast, sparkle and glow are live, and with the mic on each beat flares the sparkle.
